EcoCard is the only points card; every other card's 'points' are cash back at 1 point = $0.01.
rules.quote: The only true points-based card is the EcoCard

done_when: The customer has either applied with apply_for_credit_card (card type, full name, annual income and Rho-Bank+ status) and been told the result, or been told the card is not available to them (Diamond Elite without an invitation, Gold without Rho-Bank+). A customer who asked for advice has been recommended a card that meets every stated requirement, or been told that none fits.
